items.en: The thing is, I don't have the time.
items.example: The thing is, I don't have the time.
items.simple: You use this to say the main problem or the main point.

items.en: What I mean is, we can't afford it.
items.example: What I mean is, we can't afford it.
items.simple: You say your idea again in clearer words.

items.en: All I'm saying is, give it a try.
items.example: All I'm saying is, give it a try.
items.simple: You say this when your idea is small and simple, so nobody gets cross.

items.en: What annoys me is how long it takes.
items.example: What annoys me is how long it takes.
items.simple: You put the thing you want to stress at the end of the sentence.
items.note: Cleft cümle: What + özne + fiil + is…

items.en: It was Tom who broke the window.
items.example: It was Tom who broke the window.
items.simple: You want everyone to know exactly who did it.

items.en: It's his attitude that bothers me.
items.example: It's his attitude that bothers me.
items.simple: You say clearly which thing is the problem.

items.en: Not only did he lie, but he also blamed me.
items.tr: Sadece yalan söylemedi, beni de suçladı.
items.example: Not only did he lie, but he also blamed me.
items.exampleTr: Sadece yalan söylemedi, beni de suçladı.
items.simple: He did two bad things, and the second one makes it even worse.
items.note: Not only sonrası yardımcı fiil öne geçer.

items.en: Never have I seen such a mess.
items.example: Never have I seen such a mess.
items.simple: You say you have not seen this before, and you want to say it strongly.

items.en: Rarely do we get a chance like this.
items.example: Rarely do we get a chance like this.
items.simple: This kind of chance does not come very often.

items.en: Seldom have I felt so relieved.
items.example: Seldom have I felt so relieved.
items.simple: You almost never feel like this, so this time is special.

items.en: Hardly had I sat down when the phone rang.
items.example: Hardly had I sat down when the phone rang.
items.simple: I sat down and right at that moment the phone rang.

items.en: No sooner had we arrived than it started raining.
items.example: No sooner had we arrived than it started raining.
items.simple: We got there, and straight away the rain began.

items.en: Only then did I realise my mistake.
items.tr: Ancak o zaman hatamı fark ettim.
items.example: Only then did I realise my mistake.
items.exampleTr: Ancak o zaman hatamı fark ettim.
items.simple: I did not see the mistake before that moment.

items.en: It was only when I left that I understood.
items.example: It was only when I left that I understood.
items.simple: I did not understand until I went away.

items.en: Little did I know how hard it would be.
items.tr: Ne kadar zor olacağını hiç bilmiyordum.
items.example: Little did I know how hard it would be.
items.exampleTr: Ne kadar zor olacağını hiç bilmiyordum.
items.simple: I did not know at all that it would be hard.

items.en: Under no circumstances should you open that door.
items.example: Under no circumstances should you open that door.
items.simple: Never open it. There is no time when it is okay.

items.en: On no account must anyone know about this.
items.example: On no account must anyone know about this.
items.simple: Nobody must know. This is very important.

items.en: So tired was I that I fell asleep standing up.
items.tr: O kadar yorgundum ki ayakta uyuyakaldım.
items.example: So tired was I that I fell asleep standing up.
items.exampleTr: O kadar yorgundum ki ayakta uyuyakaldım.
items.simple: I was so very tired that I could sleep standing.

items.en: Such was the noise that nobody could sleep.
items.example: Such was the noise that nobody could sleep.
items.simple: The noise was so loud that nobody could rest.

items.en: Had I known, I would have come earlier.
items.example: Had I known, I would have come earlier.
items.simple: I did not know, so I did not come early.
items.note: If I had known yerine, daha edebi.

items.en: Should you need anything, just call me.
items.tr: Bir şeye ihtiyacın olursa beni ara.
items.example: Should you need anything, just call me.
items.exampleTr: Bir şeye ihtiyacın olursa beni ara.
items.simple: If you need something, you can ring me.

items.en: Were it not for you, I'd have failed.
items.example: Were it not for you, I'd have failed.
items.simple: You helped me. Without you, I would not have passed.

items.en: Not once did he say thank you.
items.example: Not once did he say thank you.
items.simple: He never said it, not even one time.

items.en: Nowhere is it more beautiful than here.
items.tr: Burası kadar güzel bir yer yok.
items.example: Nowhere is it more beautiful than here.
items.exampleTr: Burası kadar güzel bir yer yok.
items.simple: This is the most beautiful place of all.

items.en: Not until later did I see what he meant.
items.tr: Ne demek istediğini ancak sonra anladım.
items.example: Not until later did I see what he meant.
items.exampleTr: Ne demek istediğini ancak sonra anladım.
items.simple: I understood him only after some time had passed.
